metas.name: Knives Out
metas.description: Since you enjoyed the sequel 'Wake Up Dead Man', this original mystery provides the same sharp wit and colorful ensemble cast.

metas.name: Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery
metas.description: A perfect follow-up to your interest in the Benoit Blanc series, offering a vibrant, comedic take on the whodunnit genre.

metas.name: Guardians of the Galaxy
metas.description: Like Thor: Ragnarok, this film balances high-octane space action with a heavy dose of humor and a fantastic soundtrack.

metas.name: Kiss Kiss Bang Bang
metas.description: Written and directed by Shane Black, who did 'The Nice Guys', this features the same snappy dialogue and buddy-detective dynamic.

metas.name: Game Night
metas.description: A modern comedy masterpiece that blends mystery and action in a way that fans of 'The Nice Guys' will find hilarious.

metas.name: Bullet Train
metas.description: An ensemble action-comedy with stylized violence and witty banter, matching the energy of Thor: Ragnarok and The Nice Guys.

metas.name: Free Guy
metas.description: Much like 'Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle', this explores a video game world with a lighthearted, comedic perspective.

metas.name: Dungeons & Dragons: Honor Among Thieves
metas.description: A high-fantasy adventure that doesn't take itself too seriously, mirroring the fun ensemble vibe of Jumanji.

metas.name: Logan Lucky
metas.description: A 'hillbilly heist' movie that captures the cool, clever, and comedic crime energy found in 'Get Shorty' and 'Three Kings'.

metas.name: Ocean's Eleven
metas.description: The gold standard for stylish, fun crime comedies; its cool factor and ensemble cast align perfectly with 'Get Shorty'.

metas.name: Snatch
metas.description: A fast-paced, hilarious crime caper with a unique visual style that matches the wit of 'The Nice Guys'.

metas.name: The Gentlemen
metas.description: A return to form for Guy Ritchie, offering a fun, stylized, and comedic look at the criminal underworld.

metas.name: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
metas.description: Directed by Taika Waititi (Thor: Ragnarok), this is a heartwarming and hilarious adventure about a boy and his foster uncle.

metas.name: Deadpool
metas.description: If you liked the irreverent humor and action of Thor: Ragnarok, Deadpool's fourth-wall-breaking comedy is a great match.

metas.name: Kingsman: The Secret Service
metas.description: A high-energy spy film that prioritizes fun, gadgets, and over-the-top action sequences.

metas.name: The Fall Guy
metas.description: A love letter to stunts and action-romance that carries the same easygoing, fun energy as 'The Nice Guys'.

metas.name: The Unbearable Weight of Massive Talent
metas.description: A meta-comedy action film that is both absurd and heartwarming, perfect for a relaxing night in.

metas.name: Palm Springs
metas.description: A clever and funny sci-fi rom-com that shares the inventive spirit of 'Night Is Short, Walk On Girl'.

metas.name: Everything Everywhere All At Once
metas.description: While deeply emotional, it is a wild, imaginative, and comedic ride that fans of stylized cinema will adore.

metas.name: Paddington 2
metas.description: The ultimate feel-good movie; it is light, beautifully crafted, and universally uplifting.

metas.name: The Mitchells vs. the Machines
metas.description: A vibrant, fast-paced animated comedy about a family fighting a robot apocalypse, matching the energy of Jumanji.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
metas.description: A visually stunning and fun superhero movie that captures the same sense of wonder as Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: Hot Fuzz
metas.description: A brilliant parody of action movies that works as a great action movie itself, full of mystery and laughs.

metas.name: The Lost City
metas.description: An easy-to-watch jungle adventure that feels like a spiritual successor to the 'Jumanji' reboot.

metas.name: Shazam!
metas.description: A superhero movie that focuses more on humor and heart than dark stakes, making it very easy to watch.

metas.name: Pacific Rim
metas.description: Since you watched the sequel, the original offers even more spectacular giant robot vs. monster action with a visionary scale.

metas.name: Men in Black
metas.description: A classic sci-fi comedy that blends alien action with a buddy-cop dynamic similar to 'The Nice Guys'.

metas.name: Galaxy Quest
metas.description: A hilarious and affectionate parody of sci-fi tropes that provides great comfort and laughs.

metas.name: Lupin III: The First
metas.description: A charming and visually beautiful animated heist film that matches the whimsical tone of 'Night Is Short, Walk On Girl'.

metas.name: Rango
metas.description: A quirky, beautifully animated western comedy that appeals to fans of offbeat humor like 'Ace Ventura'.

metas.name: Confess, Fletch
metas.description: A breezy, dialogue-driven mystery comedy that will remind you of the cool vibes in 'Get Shorty'.

metas.name: Spy
metas.description: A surprisingly competent action film that is also one of the funniest comedies of the last decade.

metas.name: 21 Jump Street
metas.description: A hilarious take on the buddy-cop genre that is pure, unadulterated fun from start to finish.

metas.name: Tropic Thunder
metas.description: A satirical action-comedy that features an ensemble cast and high-stakes absurdity like 'Three Kings'.

metas.name: The Big Lebowski
metas.description: A cult classic crime-comedy with a relaxed pace and unforgettable characters, similar to the vibe of 'Get Shorty'.

metas.name: Midnight Run
metas.description: The definitive buddy-comedy action film that paved the way for movies like 'The Nice Guys'.

metas.name: A Fish Called Wanda
metas.description: A classic heist comedy featuring zany characters and the kind of slapstick wit found in 'Ace Ventura'.

metas.name: Ready Player One
metas.description: A fun, visual spectacle filled with pop-culture references, perfect for fans of Jumanji and sci-fi action.

metas.name: Ant-Man
metas.description: The most lighthearted of the Marvel films, focusing on a heist plot with plenty of visual comedy.

metas.name: Popstar: Never Stop Never Stopping
metas.description: An absurdly funny mockumentary that is light, easy to watch, and consistently hilarious.
